campaign.name: The Hollow Reach
campaign.notice: Cycle 1 is live. Claim territories before the first Downtime.

gangs.name: The Slag Sons
gangs.motto: Strength is the only law that holds.

gangs.name: Daughters of the Vial
gangs.motto: Every breath you take is ours to end.

gangs.name: The Ninth Iteration
gangs.motto: The archeotech remembers. We merely obey.

territories.name: Sump Landing
territories.boon: Recruit one Juve free each Downtime
territories.notes: Where the sump barges tie up. Everything that enters the Reach passes through here first.

territories.name: Rustfall Row
territories.boon: Search the ruins: one free Common item
territories.notes: Collapsed habs stacked nine deep. The footing is a liability and the snipers know it.

territories.name: The Glass Dome
territories.boon: Clean water: ignore one Lasting Injury roll
territories.notes: A cracked crystalflex dome. Condensation runs down the walls and someone is always collecting it.

territories.name: Vent Nine
territories.notes: The up-hive draught comes through here. So does anything that wants in quietly.

territories.name: The Chokestack
territories.notes: Furnace still runs. Nobody admits to lighting it and nobody dares let it go out.

territories.name: The Pit Market
territories.notes: Neutral ground by long tradition. Tradition here lasts about as long as the next grudge.

territories.name: The Coil Gardens
territories.notes: Pipework grown into a thicket. Van Saar say they understand it. They do not.

territories.name: The Weeping Wall
territories.notes: Groundwater bleeds through the rockcrete in sheets. The sound carries for a kilometre.

territories.name: Cinder Yard
territories.boon: Extra D6x10 credits if held two cycles
territories.notes: Ash heaps that shift without warning. Three gangs are still down there somewhere.

territories.name: The Sunken Nave
territories.boon: Reroll one Leadership test per battle
territories.notes: Cawdor built it, something else kept it. The candles are always lit and nobody sees who.

territories.name: The Black Ledger
territories.notes: Debts here are recorded in a real book. People have died trying to edit it.

territories.name: The Long Drop
territories.boon: Charge 20 credits toll per rival battle
territories.notes: One gantry across a shaft of unknown depth. Whoever holds the near end holds the Reach.

territories.name: Ratgut Tunnels
territories.notes: Not mapped, not mappable. The Delaque claim otherwise and charge for guides.

territories.name: The Bonepipe
territories.boon: One free medical escort each Downtime
territories.notes: The doc is good. The doc is also the reason several gangers answer to new names.

territories.name: The Drowned Stair
territories.notes: The stairs go down into the sump and keep going. Low tide reveals about forty more steps.

battles.summary: Opening skirmish over Rustfall Row ended with both gangs withdrawing. The Row stays contested.
